result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭軸唯一的負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#0）已進 threats 第一條並帶機率 30%，Vrbo、Booking 的點對點競爭也有列，沒有漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.thesis.R[5]","reason":"供需軸負向 supply_demand_durability#2（英國供給增加、夜數持平）已寫成 R6 並有可驗閾值，也有 trigger 12；供需持久性判為結構性、英國為局部過剩，有交代。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"法規（regulatory_antitrust#1／#2／#3）、地緣（geo_supply_chain#0／#1／#2）、替代技術（substitute_technology#0）的負向 finding 都已進 blind_spots、R1／R2／R5／R7 或 threats；reg_tariff_export#1 列入 evidence_dismissed，理由具體。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"裁決為觀望，wait_for_price=true，條件是收盤 ≤160 美元（或 FY2027 共識上修至 6.8 美元以上且夜數 ≥12% 時改 175 美元），具體可驗，與 decision_out 不矛盾；market_wrong_reason_given=false 與觀望路徑一致。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"兩個不適用軸中，customer_concentration_credit 有切題查詢（10% 客戶集中度），customer_second_source 無查詢但對平台型公司合理；判斷已寫明房東與旅客集中度事實表未涵蓋。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"roiic、reinvest_rate 寫「無法計算」、endo_ceiling 為 null，屬資料級缺口，且已改用營收成長 11.9% 當代理並承認 EPS CAGR 18.0% 超過上界；情境樹 Bull／Base／Bear EPS 價差實質，Bull 386.4、Base 261.6、Bear 99.2、EV +28.5%、IRR 6.6% 我重算都對帳。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.competitor_notes","reason":"ABNB 營業利益率 20.81% 與毛利率 82.9% 取自截至 2026-06-30 的近四季，比 Q3 最新 KPI 舊一季，但判斷已明寫期間差並同時引用 Q3 營業利益率 41.5%；屬資料級落差，其餘營運指標與 Q3 as_of 一致。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🔴","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions[6].cause","reason":"「估值與動作」條目把 p_bull_pct、p_bear_pct、max_dd_pct 三欄整包歸為純「價格變動」，但這三欄屬情境樹重建的方法變更（程式拆解已列方法變動，blind_spots 也把 Bear 25→30% 歸因於先訂後付新證據），違反「情境方法變更不得併入純價格原因」。"}]
